stem: A VPD value differs from the expected facility range while plants show no obvious change. What should Technician I check first within procedure?
choices: Assume the crop is already damaged
Measurement context such as sensor location, units, data quality and calculation method
Ignore the reading because plants look normal
rationale: Measurement context such as sensor location, units, data quality and calculation method. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
